name: mirage
text: Yes, the whole ledger, not just the wallet. Novig's API has a transactions history for the Vigilant subaccount that lists every money movement all time: each fill, fee, maker credit (bid rebate), settlement, and transfer in or out, each with a signed amount. The app's all-time profit card already reads it for the money put in and taken out ($1,078.03 in, $630.92 out). Only the Vigilant subaccount, not any other Novig account. I'll use that ledger line by line to find the ~$72 gap (CH87b).
